description: Quiz image lazy loading. The quiz photos in artifacts/electron/public/quiz-photos/ total ~3MB in unoptimized PNGs. The quiz is rendered in artifacts/electron/src/components/quiz/QuestionViews.tsx inside a modal/feature panel that is already lazy-loaded. Add loading='lazy' and decoding='async' to quiz photo img elements so they do not block the main thread. Also check if electron-logo-source.png (1.3MB) in artifacts/electron/public/ is actually used; if it is not referenced in source code, note it should be removed.
steps: 1. Read /projects/sandbox/electron/artifacts/electron/src/components/quiz/QuestionViews.tsx - locate the img element that renders quiz photos (around line 160). It renders ``.
2. Add `loading='lazy'` and `decoding='async'` attributes to that img element.

3. Check /projects/sandbox/electron/artifacts/electron/src/components/quiz/QuestionEditorPanel.tsx for any other img elements rendering quiz photos - add loading='lazy' and decoding='async' to those too.

4. Check if electron-logo-source.png is referenced in any TypeScript/TSX/CSS files: `grep -rn 'electron-logo-source' /projects/sandbox/electron/artifacts/electron/src/`. If it appears only in documentation or is not imported by any component, add a comment to the findings and note it is unused.
5. Run pnpm run typecheck from /projects/sandbox/electron to confirm no TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: img elements rendering quiz photos have loading='lazy' and decoding='async' attributes
findings: Added loading='lazy' and decoding='async' to 3 img elements: QuestionViews.tsx (ImageChoiceQuestionView), QuestionEditorPanel.tsx (ImageChoiceEditor upload preview and ImageOptionsSummary thumbnail). electron-logo-source.png is NOT referenced in any TypeScript/TSX/CSS source files (grep returned no results) - it is unused and could be removed to save ~1.3MB. pnpm typecheck has a pre-existing failure (TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'dom-chromium-installation-events') unrelated to this change - confirmed by verifying the error also occurs on the base state before any changes. Vite build passes cleanly.
